blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A 35-year-old man who had been reported missing was found dead in a village in Santa Cruz, Occidental Mindoro on Friday morning, Oct. 30, police said. The victim’s body was discovered at around 9:30 a.m. in Sitio Amnay, Barangay Barahan, after a farmer reportedly spotted his white Honda XRM 125 motorcycle in the area, according to the Santa Cruz Municipal Police Station. Investigators said the man was last seen riding the motorcycle before he went missing.
